audience: club administrators who run events, groups and members in myClub

useCases.title: List upcoming events and their spots
useCases.text: List events by date, group or venue. Open one event for its times, venue and participants.

useCases.title: Review courses and their participants
useCases.text: List the recurring classes and training series. Open one course for its schedule and participants.

useCases.title: Find members and group memberships
useCases.text: Find members by first and last name, or list the memberships of one group. Member data follows each member's privacy setting.

useCases.title: Create or update a club event
useCases.text: Create an event on the live calendar, or change its fields. Look up the venue and category ids first.

useCases.title: Read club news for members
useCases.text: List the club notifications, which are news posts for members, with an optional group filter.
